list.title: Workspaces
list.description: Every workspace on the platform, independent of your own memberships.
list.errorTitle: The workspace directory could not be loaded.
list.errorDescription: Check the workspace service and that your session still holds the platform admin role.
list.emptyDescription: Clear the search or pick a different status tab.

detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been permanently removed, or the link is wrong.
detail.loadErrorDescription: Check the workspace service and that your session still holds the platform admin role.
detail.deletedCannotChange: Deleted workspaces cannot change lifecycle state

overview.verifiedDomainRequired: Verified domain required for internal members
overview.policyNote: Last activity is the newest signal on the workspace record itself — member joins, document uploads, and settings changes. Meeting-level activity arrives with the per-workspace analytics API.

audit.emptyDescription: Suspending or reactivating this workspace records an entry here permanently.

members.errorText: The member roster could not be loaded.
members.emptyText: No active members. A deleted workspace keeps no memberships.

usage.errorText: Usage analytics could not be loaded.
usage.meetingsHint: Rooms that produced a usage record
usage.noBillableUsage: No billable usage in this window.

billing.noSubscription: This workspace has no billing subscription — it was never set up for billing.
billing.errorText: The credit ledger could not be loaded.
billing.emptyText: No credit transactions recorded for this workspace.

suspend.title: Suspend workspace
suspend.placeholder: e.g. Abuse report confirmed by customer success on 2026-08-03
suspend.description: {workspaceName} will be suspended for every member. No workspace data, meeting history, or billing record is deleted — the workspace can be reactivated later.

reactivate.title: Reactivate workspace
reactivate.placeholder: e.g. Customer remediated the reported content
reactivate.description: {workspaceName} will become active again for every member. The original suspension stays in the audit trail.

delete.title: Delete workspace
delete.description: {workspaceName} will be deleted and every membership removed with it. This cannot be undone from the portal — a deleted workspace has left the lifecycle. Billing history and the audit trail survive.

lifecycleDialog.reasonHelp: Recorded against your admin account and attached to this workspace permanently. {current}/{max}

contractBilling.contractSubtitle: Negotiated terms for an invoiced customer. Blank terms follow the plan.
contractBilling.subscriptionLoadError: The subscription could not be loaded.
contractBilling.noSubscription: No active subscription. A contract subscription can be created for this workspace.
contractBilling.serviceSuspendedSuffix: . Settling an overdue invoice does not lift this on its own.
contractBilling.footNote: A workspace already on a trial or another plan keeps that subscription: move it with Change plan on Subscriptions, then set its terms here. Create is only for a workspace with no active subscription.
contractBilling.confirmEditDescription: These terms apply to {workspaceName} immediately and are republished to its entitlements. The next invoice is raised at the contract price below.
contractBilling.confirmCreateDescription: Creates an active contract subscription for {workspaceName}. It renews every cycle and each cycle raises an invoice at the contract price below, payable by transfer.
contractBilling.planPriceNote: — the plan's price, stored as the contract price
contractBilling.formDescription: All six terms are saved together. Leave a field blank to follow the plan; a 0 overage cap switches overage off.
contractBilling.errorChoosePlan: Choose the plan this contract is written against.
contractBilling.errorPlanCurrency: {planName} is priced in {currency}. Enter the contract price in VND.
contractBilling.errorSaveTerms: The contract terms could not be saved.
contractBilling.errorCreateContract: The contract could not be created.
contractBilling.resumeDialogDescription: Lifts the suspension on {workspaceName} and republishes its entitlements. If another invoice is still overdue, the hourly overdue sweep suspends it again.
contractBilling.resumeReasonPlaceholder: Recorded in the billing service log.
contractBilling.resumeReasonTooShort: Give a reason of at least ten characters, such as the bank reference that cleared.
contractBilling.errorResumeService: The service could not be resumed.
contractBilling.invoicesSubtitle: Mark an open invoice paid once its bank transfer has arrived.
contractBilling.invoicesEmpty: No invoices yet. A contract raises its first one when the billing cycle closes.
contractBilling.recordPaymentDescription: Marks the invoice and its payment paid, dated now. It grants no credits — the cycle already did — and it cannot be undone from the portal.
contractBilling.confirmInvoiceLabel: Type the invoice number <num>{invoiceNumber}</num> to confirm
contractBilling.errorMarkPaid: The invoice could not be marked paid.
